private_workbook_limitations: These research copies alter several thickness strings and include additional sites. B-TmR has 89 positive rows and a separate 116-row zero table whose observational status and detection limits were not verified. It is not substituted for the published source.

source_semantics.ranges: Thirteen source ranges were reduced to single endpoints or midpoints in the accepted table; their geological/measurement interpretation remains to be checked before an interval likelihood is chosen.
source_semantics.spots: Two source entries explicitly describe spots; treating them as representative undisturbed thickness is unverified.
source_semantics.suigetsu: Source row 49 is <0.1 cm; current CSV row 82 uses exact 0.1 cm.
source_semantics.kushu: Source row 48 reports no visible ash layer, with cryptotephra presence described in supporting text; current CSV row 84 uses exact 0.1 cm without a source-established bulk thickness.
source_semantics.absence: Supporting text discusses marine preservation and reporting limitations; unreported layered ash is not automatically zero original fallout.
